title: Tracer-Cloud/opensre: build agents for production reliability work
friendlyTitle: OpenSRE helps teams build AI agents for system incidents
summary: OpenSRE is an actively developed Python toolkit for building AI agents that investigate incidents and support site-reliability work. The project has about 11,600 GitHub stars, frequent releases and integrations intended for operational tools and evidence gathering.
friendlySummary: OpenSRE is a popular open toolkit for agents that investigate software and infrastructure problems.
whyItMatters: Platform teams can study or assemble agent workflows for diagnostics, incident context and repeatable operational actions instead of starting from a blank framework. Test it in a sandbox with read-only access first: reliability tooling can touch highly privileged systems, and agent-generated diagnoses still require experienced review.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Operations teams can use it as a starting point for incident tools. Begin with read-only access and keep an experienced person in charge.
